verdict.rationale: SumUp is a payments platform, so user-configurable background automations are a fair axis. However, the pack documents no feature for creating autonomous, scheduled or triggered automations. The MCP server, Agent Toolkit and SDKs are developer building blocks for constructing agents. The checkout status-change notification is an adjacent capability, and 'automated marketing' is a separate POS plan feature, not a user-defined automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
